title: Predicting LLM Inference Latency From Inputs — A Project Report (Part 1 predictor + Part 2 utility)
summary_zh: 對外、自足的專案報告。第一部分：以近乎零剖析、從輸入參數預測每步 GPU 推論時間——roofline 效率因子寫成架構量的封閉式（H100 989 TFLOP/s 五因子分解、Hopper cluster 上限 112/132、L2 飽和律、重疊修正 α）。第二部分：把該預測器接進四個真實服務系統（DistServe、Vidur、QLM、Splitwise）的決策模組。誠實狀態：decode 0.8–3.7%、DistServe 1.78% 對 2.27%（零剖析）、僅憑規格完美排名 4 GPU；但 prefill ~17–21% 為弱點、Vidur RF 在本機 MAPE 勝出、QLM SLO 為負結果。每個數字皆引結果檔。
summary_en: Self-contained, advisor-facing project report. Part 1: predict per-step GPU inference time from input parameters with almost no profiling — roofline efficiency factors written as closed forms in architecture quantities (H100 989 TFLOP/s five-factor decomposition, Hopper cluster cap 112/132, L2 saturation law, overlap correction α). Part 2: drop the predictor into the decision modules of four real serving systems (DistServe, Vidur, QLM, Splitwise). Honest status: decode 0.8–3.7%, DistServe 1.78% vs 2.27% (zero profiling), perfect 4-GPU ranking from specs; but prefill ~17–21% is the weakness, Vidur's RF wins home-SKU MAPE, and QLM SLO is a null. Every number cites a result file.
